categories.summary: Two vector formats: SVG (sanitized, full path commands, curve flattening) and DXF (clean-room ASCII parser: LINE/CIRCLE/ARC/LWPOLYLINE/classic POLYLINE/ELLIPSE/SPLINE, recursive INSERT/MINSERT to depth 8, $INSUNITS units, ACI layer colors; TEXT/HATCH skipped with counts). categories.summary: Re-importing a same-filename SVG/DXF replaces the placed object in place, keeping object id, transform, and per-color layer settings, and toasts a kept/new/removed color diff. Replacement is unconditional — no 'import as copy' choice (S1-F5; an un-ADR'd divergence from LightBurn's add-a-copy). Raster images always add fresh. No linked-file watching or update-from-source beyond manual re-import.
